scientific_summary: The marginal CDFs of all order statistics of independent nonidentically distributed variables determine the pointwise multiset of parent CDF values. Continuous two-parent aliases are exactly componentwise label braids; interval-rigid classes such as real-analytic CDFs are globally identified up to permutation, while full-support positive-density C-infinity counterexamples exist.
limitations: Classical heterogeneous-order-statistic forward formulas and their symmetric-product representation are not new. The novelty claim is restricted to the exact pointwise-multiset equivalence class, two-parent braid classification, interval-identity/analytic identification theorem, and smooth full-support nonidentification construction.
